title: On Aching for three whole days
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：ache　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ache 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the wound ① ached for three whole days twice over, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the wound ② aches for three whole days year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ ache for three whole days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ ached for three whole days before — a line in the list for June 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Aching for three whole days twice over, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the wound ever ⑥ aches in the damp weather year after year before the June rains, nobody in the office would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ ache in the damp weather year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a second wound ⑧ aches in the damp weather twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the office said a word;  The wound ached for three whole days again in 1989, and this time nothing was written down.

To ache for three whole days, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, the wound aches for three whole days year after year again and the wound must ache for three whole days twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 疼（一般过去式 ached for three whole days：1979 年那处伤口头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 疼（一般现在 aches for three whole days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 疼（不定式 to ache for three whole days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 疼（过去完成时 had ached for three whole days：1973 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 疼（动名词 aching for three whole days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 隐隐作痛（aches in the damp weather：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真隐隐作痛遇上潮气就疼）
G. v. 隐隐作痛（ache in the damp weather：let it 之后的原形，指随它去遇上潮气就疼）
H. v. 疼（后段两处：后来的那处伤口照例 aches in the damp weather，而那处伤口在 1989 年又一次 ached for three whole days）

items.q: to ache for three whole days
ached for three whole days before
aches in the damp weather year after year
ache in the damp weather year after year and
aches in the damp weather twice over

answers.why: ache 意为“疼”，1979 年那处伤口来回两遍疼整整三天，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 ached。
ache 意为“疼”，自那以后那处伤口年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 aches。
ache 意为“疼”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯疼整整三天”，此处为不定式 to ache for three whole days。
ache 意为“疼”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人疼过，故用过去完成时 had ached。
ache 意为“疼”，那处伤口说“疼整整三天这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 aching for three whole days 作主语。
ache 意为“隐隐作痛”，叔叔说的是“万一那处伤口真隐隐作痛遇上潮气就疼”，if 从句里用一般现在 aches in the damp weather。
ache 意为“隐隐作痛”，老手们的规矩是“随它隐隐作痛遇上潮气就疼”（let it ache in the damp weather），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
ache 意为“疼”，后来的那处伤口每个星期都照例隐隐作痛遇上潮气就疼，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 aches。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，那处伤口来回两遍疼整整三天；邮局里每一个寄信人都说这是头一回。（ached for three whole days）
多年以后，那处伤口仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（aches for three whole days）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯疼整整三天这件事本身。（to ache for three whole days）
早在 1973 年就有人疼整整三天，六月那天收发清单上的一行字就是证据。（had ached for three whole days）

老手们留下的规矩说得明白：随它隐隐作痛遇上潮气就疼，以后再也不要提起。（let it ache in the damp weather）
